newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Mandarin Res chief court action dismissed.
newsitem.headline: Mandarin Res chief court action dismissed.

text.p: The Hong Kong High Court dismissed proceedings brought by Mandarin Resources Corp Ltd chairman Chim Pui-chung against Mark Dickens, executive director of enforcement of the Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission (SFC), the SFC said on Friday.
The industry watchdog said in a statement proceedings against Dickens' predecessor, Gerard McMahon, were also dismissed.
The SFC said the order dismissing the action was made with the consent of Chim.
Chim was not immediately available for comment.
The action had claimed that Dickens and McMahon had been guilty of misfeasance in public office in connection with the question of relisting Mandarin Resources, it said.
